blocks.text: When the RBI Governor speaks, your EMI moves.

items: RBI increases Repo Rate to suck money out of the system.
Banks increase Loan Rates to match RBI.
Your Home Loan Tenure increases silently from 20 years to 25 years.

summary: How one RBI rate decision moves your EMI, your FD returns, and the market — in that order.
title: RBI & You
